source_findings: The EMA-Gram wrapper calls jax.local_devices()/device.memory_stats() in its finally block after run_levanter_train_lm returns. A repair must not shut JAX down inside train_lm before this wrapper completes.
TelemetryTracker.finish publishes FINISHED, stops its heartbeat, then closes Finelog. This phase marker is an application phase, not an acknowledgment of delivered telemetry.
LevanterMetricsWriter already exposes Finelog FlushResult through flush(timeout). Reuse this evidence instead of interpreting close() returning None as success.
Finelog flush consumes the dropped-since-last-flush counter; one final successful flush cannot certify lifetime losslessness. Persist/aggregate earlier receipts if used for integrity.

Existing Iris compile_guard uses host coordinator key_value_set/dir_get and wait_at_barrier. This supports a candidate host-only exchange API, but does not establish shutdown placement or health behavior.

findings: In the accepted checkout, complete_job is a force-completion operation: it sets unfinished tasks successful and stops them. It is not a read-only acknowledgment of their natural exit.
The same checkout also supports natural job success through recompute_state when all task states are SUCCEEDED.
The callable runner preserves uncaught errors in sys.last_exc for the existing atexit guard. Ordinary atexit exceptions alone do not guarantee nonzero process exit.
completion_gate_review.candidate_decision: The isolated future finalizer never calls complete_job. It leaves canonical aggregation to natural per-task exits, avoiding a local completion call masking a late peer failure. This choice still needs controller/runtime qualification.
limits: The deployed controller revision was not established by this source review.
No historical task status, finished-ONLINE result or scientific classification is changed by this design observation.
No claim that force completion caused either observed shutdown failure.

limitations: Caller must quiesce producers before requesting a receipt; concurrent producer/finalizer safety is not established.
Local successful sink return is not a remote-delivery or complete-history certificate. Existing canonical/ONLINE/history gates remain necessary.
CompositeTracker and Finelog finalization outcomes are not yet integrated.
Outstanding background workers and asymmetric multi-rank teardown remain unresolved. No coordinator barrier or timeout changes applied.
Safe JAX shutdown or atexit ordering
